description: A viral disease of grapevines that reduces yield and fruit quality. It causes leaf rolling, discoloration, and poor grape ripening.
symptoms: Leaves roll downward from the edges
Red or purple leaves in red varieties
favorable_conditions: Presence of mealybugs and scale insects
biological_control: Encourage natural enemies of mealybugs such as lady beetles
Use parasitoid wasps to control vectors
chemical_control: Insecticides to control mealybugs (e.g., imidacloprid, spirotetramat)
Horticultural oils to reduce vector populations
